sourceEntries.originalText: The calculation of the food income from garrisoned herdable animals now uses a non-linear calculation, where garrisoning additional herdable animals has diminishing returns. 15 \*(ln FoodAmount/200+1), where FoodAmount is the sum of food in all garrisoned herdable animals.
